subject: Surveying and fitting around business operations
hook: Most of your office fit happens in our workshop, not your office
ig:
Most of your office fit happens in our workshop, not your office.

When a business is still trading, the dusty, noisy part of furniture making shouldn't happen in your reception. So this is how we work on commercial jobs:

We survey around your day, noting sockets, data points, door widths and lift access.

Panels are cut, edged and drilled in our Hanley workshop. Carcasses are assembled and checked there too, wherever size and access allow.

What arrives on site is furniture that's ready to position, level and fix. Less cutting on your floor means less dust, less noise and fewer hours with the team in the way.

Where a piece is too big for the stairs or lift, we plan the joins at design stage and assemble it in place.

Comment FITOUT and we'll send you the link to our commercial furniture page.
fb:
A quick look at why our commercial installs tend to be quieter than people expect.

The cutting, edging, drilling and most of the assembly happen in our workshop in Hanley, not in your office. We survey around your working day, build and check the furniture here, then bring it in ready to level and fix. If a piece won't fit through a door or lift in one go, we plan where it splits at the design stage.

It means less dust and noise for your staff and customers. If you're planning a fit-out, here's how we approach installation:
